6. Admit.
7.
On the last date of hearing, notice was issued to Respondent Nos. 1-3 and TCR was directed to be requisitioned.
8. Today, Mr. Y. P. Uniyal, ld. Counsel appears for Respondent Nos. 1-3 and seeks permission to obtain the copy of TCR.
Further Respondent Nos. 1- 3 are also present in Court today.

9. Accordingly, the Registry is directed to prepare the appeal paperbook with proper indexing,
pagination and bookmarks expeditiously and provide digitized copies thereof to learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the parties, upon request.
Let the TCR be tagged along with this appeal by the next date of hearing.
10. In addition, it is directed that one of the Respondents amongst Respondent Nos. 1-3 shall remain present in Court on all dates of hearing.
11. None appears for Appellant.
